This plot is small, only about the size of a compound garden, and I planted it with yam. I don't usually buy NPK for yam because it's expensive and yam does not respond to it the way maize does — I rely on the fertility of the mounds and some goat manure I carry from the house. I will use my own setts from last season's harvest, like I always do. The hardest work is making the mounds and weeding, so I will call two of my brothers for a few days to help, but most of the work I'll do myself with my wife and older son.
